signal: The intelligent document processing market Data Dimensions serves is projected to grow from $2.3B to $12.35B by 2030, a 33% CAGR, putting pressure on business development to cover demand.

email.subject1: a signal play for Data Dimensions
email.body1:
Kevin, with the IDP market Data Dimensions plays in projected to grow over 33% a year through 2030, demand is accelerating fast.

A tailwind like that usually means more in-market accounts than the BD team can cover, and that is where pipeline slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Data Dimensions off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Kevin, quick follow-up for Data Dimensions.

A growing market usually pushes the BD number up faster than headcount can cover. Most leaders don't actually know how many meetings the team needs to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Data Dimensions needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Kevin, last bit of proof for Data Dimensions.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Data Dimensions' reply rate likely compares to similar automation teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Kevin, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD pipeline without adding reps isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Chasing a fast-growing market is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a business development motion? I'll tailor it to Data Dimensions either way.
